sources.label: Morphe Patches
sources.author: Minecraft PE
patch_list: Adds a documents provider so the app's data folders can be accessed from the system file manager.
Add libmtbinloader2.so to the app's native library path.
Changes the app name shown in the launcher.
Replaces the app icon shown in the launcher into the patch logo. You can set a custom icon if you want other icons.
Changes the app package name to install patch without uninstalling original app. By default, .morphe is appended.
Removes music files. This reduces app size.
